title: Launcher & interface
summary: Install updates, use the interface and resolve launch problems.
body:
One shortcut and automatic updates

Your usual Nightcap shortcut updates the launcher and game before Play. Fully close both the game and launcher before updating, then reopen that shortcut. Keep your existing game folder; another game installation can stay running during an update.

Read each release’s changes

The launcher shows dated Feature and Bug fix summaries for the current update, plus expandable previous patches. Close the game and launcher, then reopen your usual shortcut when updating. Use Features for the current systems and Recent changes for the wiki’s release history.

The Nightcap interface loads automatically

Class labels, the ability Class column, and custom pet and loot controls load with the game.

Spellbook, spell gems, and mana for your build

A melee starting class can use the spellbook and spell gems when your held classes provide spell access. The mana gauge follows your actual mana pool.

Classic character and creature appearances

Supported older models are used where available, including original elemental colors. Creatures without an older counterpart retain their appearance. The game’s model configuration also supports opting into modern appearances; a full restart is required.

Ten original paintings across the loading gallery

All 55 numbered loading screens and the fallback now use ten original Nightcap paintings, including the SoulFire Paladin and the gnome with three pets. The launcher installs the complete gallery while preserving your settings.

If a zone fails to load

Fully close EverQuest, reopen your usual launcher, select the game folder you actually use and press Play. Missing or corrupted managed terrain and object archives are downloaded; matching files and personal settings are preserved. If a zone still fails, report its name and the exact error. A full reinstall is usually unnecessary.

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

The Warhelm appearance needs the paired Classic client archives. Close EverQuest and use normal launcher Play to install release 2026102402 before equipping the helmet.
